Claim 1 (Currently amended): A battery assembly comprising: an enclosure; a first battery cell positioned within the enclosure; and a first sensor positioned within the enclosure for detecting at least one force influencing the first battery cell, wherein the first sensor is a __force sensing material having a conductance that varies based on the at least one force__.

Claim 21 (Currently amended): The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises: __a force sensing material having a conductance that is configured to vary based on the at least one force influencing the first battery cell; and force sensing circuitry coupled to the force sensing material, wherein the force sensing circuitry is configured to produce a force output signal based on the conductance of the force sensing material__.

Claim 22 (Currently amended): The battery assembly of claim 21, wherein the force sensing material comprises at least one variable electrical conductor, __wherein the at least one variable electrical conductor has a first level of electrical conductance when the at least one variable electrical conductor is quiescent, and wherein the at least one variable electrical conductor has a second level of conductance when a mechanical stress is applied to the at least one variable electrical conductor__.

Claim 25 (Currently amended): The battery assembly of claim 1, wherein the first sensor comprises __a contact sensor configured to detect mechanical forces applied to the first battery cell__.
